description: This file contains code for generating fake client implementations for Kubernetes API groups, including functions to create target files for group-specific fake clients and a fake clientset, with associated generator configurations.

methods.name: TargetForGroup
methods.description: Generates a target configuration for creating fake client code for a specific API group version, including files for each type and the group itself.

methods.name: TargetForClientset
methods.description: Creates a target configuration for generating a fake clientset for testing, including core files like clientset and scheme registration.
